import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartTwistCollapse

/-!
# A plus class becomes honest over its own étale carrier — over an ARBITRARY affine base

This closes the obligation the CHART-U(b) header table names "honesty over a general affine
base" (issue I-0558), and it needs no field.

## The obligation, and why it looked hard

`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean`'s route needs a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over an affine base
whose class is the (collapsed) twisted class.  `exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass`
(`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean`) supplies the datum — but it takes an **honest Čech
class** `c` over the base as a *hypothesis*, and a plus class over `Spec A` is not honest: it is
`PicEtAff.mk E x` for an étale cover `E` of `A`.

The tree's only route from a plus class to an honest one was
`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`'s `exists_splitting_of_picEt`, which requires `[Field K]` — its
engine is étale field-cofinality (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`),
false over a general base.  So the obligation read as: find a *substitute* for cofinality over
`Spec A`.

## Why it is in fact free

There is no substitute needed, because **a cover splits over its own carrier**.  The
field-cofinality theorem is used to produce an `A`-algebra map `E.Carrier →ₐ L` into something
where the class becomes a unit; but the identity `E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier` is already such a
map, and it exists for every cover over every base.  Restricting the plus class along
`A → E.Carrier` therefore makes it honest, with no finiteness, separability, or field
hypothesis anywhere.

Concretely `PicEtAff.map C E.Carrier (PicEtAff.mk C E x) = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier x` — the
transported class is presented by `x` itself.  The proof is the general-base analogue of
`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom` (`Picard/PicEtAffFieldCollapse.lean:79`), which is stated
only for fields; the field hypotheses there are inherited from *its* consumer (the degree seam,
which reads a degree and so needs a field), not required by the argument.  The one substantive
step is the same in both: the descent condition `x.2`, fed to `relPicAlgMap_congr`, identifies
the two ways of transporting `x` to the base-changed carrier.

## What this does and does not give

It gives honesty **over `Spec E.Carrier`**, not over `Spec A`.  That is exactly what the
(b-amendment) asks for — its step is "over the étale carrier `B := E.Carrier` the class is
honest", after which the engine fires on `Spec B` and transport (ii) pushes the open locus down
to `Spec A` along the (open, surjective) carrier map.  Nothing here performs that descent; the
topological core of it is landed as `isOpen_of_isOpen_comap_preimage`
(`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusOpen.lean:129`).

So after this file the CHART-U(b) route has ONE remaining obligation, the pointwise
`IsChartDatumPresentation` — and, unlike the previous "one remaining obligation" claims on this
lane, that one is a genuine statement about matching two fibre predicates, not a missing
construction.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self` — **a plus class is honest over its own
  cover carrier**, over an arbitrary affine base.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_honest_of_picEtAff` — the existential form.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_datum_cechPicClass_of_picEtAff` — the payoff: for any plus class
  over any affine base there is a cover carrier `B` and a datum over `B` presenting the class
  twisted by any chart index.  This is the input of the engine, with its honesty hypothesis
  discharged.
-/

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

noncomputable section

/-! ## Honesty over the cover's own carrier -/

variable (C) in
/-- **A plus class becomes the plus-unit of an honest class over its own cover carrier**, over
an ARBITRARY affine base `A` — no field, no finiteness, no separability.

`PicEtAff.map C E.Carrier (PicEtAff.mk C E x) = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier x`: the class
presented by `x` on the cover `E` restricts, along `A → E.Carrier`, to the tautological plus
unit of `x` itself.

This is the general-base analogue of `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom`
(`Picard/PicEtAffFieldCollapse.lean:79`) at `ℓ := AlgHom.id`.  That lemma carries `[Field K]`,
`[Field L]` because *its* consumer (the degree seam) reads a degree; the argument itself uses
neither.  The substantive content, identical in both, is the **descent condition** `x.2`: the
two ways of carrying `x` into the base-changed carrier — along `E.baseChangeInclude` and along
`Algebra.ofId` — agree on a descent class, which is what `relPicAlgMap_congr` consumes.

Why this matters: the tree's only previous route from a plus class to an honest one was étale
field-cofinality (`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`), which is field-only, so "honesty over a general
affine base" was recorded as an unlanded *construction*.  It is not a construction at all — a
cover splits over its own carrier, and the identity map is the splitting. -/
theorem PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
    PicEtAff.map C E.Carrier (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
  rw [PicEtAff.map_mk, PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C (E.baseChange E.Carrier)]
  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C (E.baseChange E.Carrier)) (Subtype.ext ?_)
  rw [descentBaseChange_coe]
  exact relPicAlgMap_congr C (E.baseChangeInclude E.Carrier)
    ((Algebra.ofId E.Carrier (E.baseChange E.Carrier).Carrier).restrictScalars A) x.2

variable (C) in
/-- **Every plus class over an affine base is honest over some affine base above it** — the
existential form of `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self`, which is how a consumer meets it: it does
not get to choose `B`, it gets a `B` from the class's own presentation.

Compare `exists_splitting_of_picEt` (`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`): that gives a *field*
extension and requires the base to be a field; this gives an étale extension and requires
nothing.  The two are the field and general-base halves of the same move, and the chart layer
needs both — the field one to read the split witness predicate at a point, this one to run the
engine over a base. -/
theorem exists_honest_of_picEtAff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : Algebra A B)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k A B) (z : relPic C (overSpec k B)),
      PicEtAff.map C B a = PicEtAff.unit C B z := by
  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
  | mk E x =>
    refine ⟨E.Carrier, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)), ?_⟩
    exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x

/-! ## The payoff: the engine's input, with honesty discharged -/

variable (C π) in
/-- **The engine input, assembled**: for any plus class over any affine base `A` and any chart
index `(m, Z)`, there is an affine base `B` above `A` and a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `B`
whose class is the class of `a` (read honestly over `B`) twisted by the chart index.

This composes the two halves that were previously recorded as separate gates:

* honesty over `B := E.Carrier` — `exists_honest_of_picEtAff` above, which needs no field;
* presentation of the twisted class by a datum — `exists_cechPicClass_eq`, applied at the
  *product* class, which is why no `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.mul` is needed
  (`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean`).

The conclusion is exactly the input of
`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`, so the openness of the witness
locus over `Spec B` is available for every plus class and every chart index.  What is *not* here
is the identification of that locus with `chartLocus` — that is
`IsChartDatumPresentation`, the one genuine remaining obligation of CHART-U(b). -/
theorem exists_datum_cechPicClass_of_picEtAff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (a : PicEtAff C A) (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : Algebra A B)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k A B) (z : relPic C (overSpec k B)),
      PicEtAff.map C B a = PicEtAff.unit C B z
        ∧ ∀ c : (relCurve C B).CechPic, relPicMk C (overSpec k B) c = z →
            ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
              D.cechPicClass
                = c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z) := by
  obtain ⟨B, _, _, _, _, z, hz⟩ := exists_honest_of_picEtAff C a
  exact ⟨B, ‹CommRing B›, ‹Algebra k B›, ‹Algebra A B›, ‹IsScalarTower k A B›, z, hz,
    fun c _ => exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass c m Z⟩

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

The hgraph lives at `/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/hgraph/nodes/` (8590 node files, 5391 edges), with **no config file** in `hgraph/` — only `nodes/` and `edges/`. Also: the four ground-truth commits (`e6a7b0582`, `a5da2f1a1`, `8ef9493ff`, `f7e337d222`) exist in **no** git repo I can reach — the owning repo `/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon` has *zero commits on main* and `hgraph/` is untracked, so my ground truth is the worktree source, not HEAD.

## The three flagged nodes: all three CONFIRMED

**1. `hgraph/nodes/a40ec58fab2b.md` — CONFIRMED, worst of the three.** `decl: is`, `title: is`, `lean_status: sorry`, file `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean`. This is a **phantom node**: there is no declaration named `is`; the sync scraper mis-parsed the header prose line 78, `theorem is real mathematics (it is the three transports plus the dictionary), and the`. Its stale body text:

```
hypothesis is a single, precisely stated obligation which the GAP-1 mul/tensor brick will
discharge.
```

Current source (line 76-77) reads instead: `hypothesis is a single, precisely stated obligation.  (An earlier draft said the GAP-1 / mul/tensor brick would discharge it; see the struck table row for why that was wrong.)`. Two defects: retracted GAP-1 gate claim, and `lean_status: sorry` on a sorry-free file. Correct `lean_status: lean_ok` — but the right fix is deletion, since the node has no referent.

**2. `hgraph/nodes/093ee50083e8.md` — CONFIRMED** (`decl: AlgebraicGeometry.IsChartDatumPresentation`, `lean_status: lean_ok`, which is correct; the docstring is stale). Two exact stale fragments in `docstring:`:

- `the class equality is what needs `cechPicClass_inv` and\n  the mul/tensor of GAP-1, whereas a lane...` → source now says `...needs `cechPicClass_inv` and a class-level identification, whereas...`
- `it made the statement unprovable (an arbitrary regrading of `κ(t)` over `A` is not a legal reading of the fibre)` → source now says `false for some regradings (`HasWitnessH1Vanishing` reads its `Algebra` instance inside `relCurveMap`, so a non-canonical `alg` names a different set)`.
```
it is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis
*per affine piece*, which is a statement about the general test and therefore belongs with
the mul/tensor brick that produces the presentations.
```

Source now ends `...therefore belongs with the honesty/presentation obligations named in header table.`

## Four others the reviewer did not flag

**4. `hgraph/nodes/92bbf763d41e.md` — the sign error, verbatim in the body.** `decl: AlgebraicGeometry.chartTwist`. Stored body:

```lean
  lam * sigmaFamily C Z T * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m)⁻¹
```

Current source (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:176`): `lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹`. This node is the *only* place in the whole 8590-node graph still carrying the pre-I-0514 definition that made `chartLocus` empty for every `g >= 1`. Its `docstring` matches source (both are sign-neutral prose), so the frontmatter looks clean — the defect is body-only. The node is also missing the entire "Sign discipline" paragraph and has no record of `chartTwist_chartValue` (verified present, `Pic0ChartLocus.lean:211`, axiom-clean).

**5. `hgraph/nodes/9ebfe7a49f24.md` — the old fibre degree, in both docstring and body.** `decl: AlgebraicGeometry.degAt_chartTwist`. Docstring says `the twisted family has fibre degree `deg Z − m·d₁` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `−g``; and `so the two agree at `n = 0``. Body states `= Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z - (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)`. Current source: degree is `(m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z`, i.e. `m·d₁ − deg Z`, `+g`, and the comparison point is `degAt_chartValue` at **`n = g`, NOT at `n = 0`**.

**6. `hgraph/nodes/a10dde85059b.md` — same old sign, propagated into `IsSplitWitness`.** `decl: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSplitWitness`. Stale docstring fragment: `the twisted class has fibre degree `deg Z − m·d₁`, which the constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` makes `−g`.  It is *not* a hypothesis of this predicate;`. Correct: `m·d₁ − deg Z` ... makes `+g`, plus the new parenthetical `(Until 2026-07-28 this read `−g`, and that sign made the locus empty for every `g ≥ 1` — see `degAt_chartTwist` and issue I-0514; `chartTwist_chartValue` now pins the direction by the kernel)`.

**7. `hgraph/nodes/58767c9ef3b9.md` and `hgraph/nodes/68356d4c7e4c.md` — the collapsed class, inverted.** `chartTwist_collapse` and `chartTwistClass` both store `Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass k Z * (thetaCechClass C ^ m)⁻¹`; current source has `thetaCechClass C ^ m * (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass k Z)⁻¹` (`Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean:170` and `:181`). `58767c9ef3b9.md`'s docstring repeats the inverted class twice in prose: `= λ · thetaFamily C (picClass k Z · (θ^m)⁻¹) T` and `at the single class `picClass k Z · (θ^m)⁻¹``; source says `(θ^m · (picClass k Z)⁻¹)` / `θ^m · (picClass k Z)⁻¹`. `68356d4c7e4c.md`'s docstring is sign-neutral, so its defect is body-only. Same root cause as #4 — these are the downstream shadow of the chartTwist sign flip.

## Two further defects, different kind

`hgraph/nodes/43296ad3931b.md` (`isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField`, `lean_status: lean_ok`, correct) carries the same overclaim as #2, one word: docstring says `the hypothesis form is *unprovable*`, source now says `*false for some regradings*`.

`hgraph/nodes/e628df6d2739.md` (`algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors`) says `lean_status: sorry`. **Refuted** — the declaration exists at `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:184` with a complete proof, `#print axioms` clean. Correct value `lean_ok`. Docstring and body both match source. So `a40ec58fab2b.md` is not the only wrong-status node on that file; there are two.

`hgraph/nodes/4e81cafc3551.md` (`isSplitWitness_of_splitting`, `lean_status: lean_ok`) points at a declaration that was **written and then deliberately removed** — `Pic0ChartSplit.lean:178-179` documents the removal explicitly ("was written and then **removed**, because it cannot be elaborated at acceptable cost"). This node already carries `stale: true` in its frontmatter, so it is self-flagged; `lean_ok` is nonetheless wrong for a nonexistent declaration. Worth deleting.

## Scope check

I diffed all 45 nodes whose `file:` is one of the six against current source (docstring word-diff plus body-prefix match). Stale set is exactly the nine above. The remaining 36 match. I also checked the 14 neighbouring nodes on sibling Picard files (`Pic0ChartLocusOpen`, `Pic0ChartLocusClass`, `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField`, `Pic0ChartTestPoint`, `DivisorDatumInverse`) for old-sign or retracted-gate phrasing: **clean**. Five other phantom nodes on these files came from the same prose mis-parse and claim `lean_ok` for nothing: `1893eaf0f55f.md` (`decl: and`), `7a6f72b2cc08.md` (`decl: with`), `3d0af5aa99d9.md` (`decl: `M``), `34c57eb1bbf3.md` (`decl: COV-1,`), `2e979157e2c6.md` (`decl: over`). Not stale in your sense — they never had a referent — but they inflate the node count and none carries `stale: true`. `b08df3119c8b.md` (`Scheme.IsGluingCocycle.inv`) looked phantom to my regex but is real: it is declared as `theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsGluingCocycle.inv` at `Pic0ChartShiftedDatum.lean:91`.
